Sakurako"No..."

Doushin"Hill 203 was perfect ground for observation and artillery. Take this hill and we could put a lid on the besieged army, which comes out whenever it sees an opening to threaten our control of the air. The flow of the war would change."
Doushin"Therefore, he said, bombard that hill now. ...Even where enemy and friendly troops were packed in together."
Sakurako"!? But that is—"
Doushin"General Nogi naturally refused in one sentence. 'Can I fire my guns on the Emperor's children?' But Lord Yoritsuna would not retreat. Thinking back, that stubborn nature was there from those days only."
Doushin"'Until today, Your Excellency has let His Majesty's children die for nothing. From today, please grant His Majesty's children deaths that have a purpose.'"
Doushin"He said it straight to the General! Born of a great family, yes, but still only an army officer. Such nerve, I tell you."
Doushin"But that sincerity moved General Nogi. The bombardment was carried out, and our forces finally seized Hill 203. The tide of the war turned in a single night."
Doushin"...Lord Yoritsuna truly knew how human lives may be used. What it really means to give a life a purpose!"
Sakurako"..."
Doushin"Did Lord Yoritsuna never tell the Princess such stories?"

Princess Sakurako was asking him...

Her voice had frozen stiff. Like washing left out under a winter sky.

Nine-tenths of my mind had gone blank. In the one-tenth remaining, I thought: how ugly. Her smile was falling apart, and she was forcing it to stay on her face. It looked foul. Unbearably ugly.

A person's face could become like this?

And opposite her, the monk was beautiful.

Endless joy. Love for everything in the world, without bottom, without end. It filled his smile. A smile from heaven itself.

As though the Buddha had descended.
